manual_checklist.title: Internal + external parasite treatment between 5 and 30 days before entry
manual_checklist.detail: A licensed vet administers internal + external antiparasitic treatment between 5 and 30 days before entry and attests it on the export certificate. Treating in the final 4 days is a hard fail — do NOT leave it to the last minute.

manual_checklist.title: Certificate must be in Spanish AND English
manual_checklist.detail: APHIS states Chile's certificate must be in both Spanish and English, and an APHIS-endorsed paper copy must physically accompany the shipment.

manual_checklist.title: Be ready for SAG inspection at the port of entry
manual_checklist.detail: Pets without required paperwork may be refused entry. Even compliant animals may be placed under official observation for at least 30 days at SAG's discretion. Carry both the originals and copies.

sources.page_title: Pet Travel From the United States to Chile
supporting_requirements: Chile-specific certificate + APHIS endorsement (not generic Form 7001)
